page.overview:
Who is Benoit Dubois?

Benoit Dubois is a French intelligence asset who appeared in the 2015 video-game James Bond: World of Espionage, during its Slow Down Faster story-line.

Born in Marseille in France, Benoit is brother to Justine Dubois and nephew of Rene Dubois. He is the technical side of the family and is involved in all manner of plots, from those sanctioned by the Deuxième Bureau, to those that deal with shady underworld car races. Benoit is skilled in driving, firearms and surveillance, and is multilingual, speaking French, German and English. Benoit was assigned to assist James Bond by his sister Justine and drives him to the mountain villa of Ludovic de Baleine.

The character offers a buff to the player's offence attribute and provides a +5 Energy bonus using armored cars and a +2 stamina bonus using fake moustaches. He is a 'common agent' (white) and can be levelled to level 5.
